verdict.rationale: E2B's docs include a dedicated coding-agents use-case page for running Claude Code, Codex, and Amp in sandboxes with full terminal, filesystem, and git access. They also document a pre-built `claude` template with Claude Code already installed. Custom templates and `commands.run()` provide the general mechanism for installing and launching other agents. Missing for 10: a detailed Codex-specific recipe (Codex is only named, not walked through) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the recipes work as documented.
